svg.title: Welder — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as welder, wearing an apron and a welding helmet. Visible work cue: A welding electrode holder aims a thin electrode toward a metal seam, with two short functional spark strokes. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a welding helmet.
